claims: Tao1108.1165v4 section9 controls finite total speed, with E^(1/2) T^(1/4)+E in its R3, unit-viscosity, finite-energy almost-smooth solution setting.

The estimate provides no uniform square-root interval modulus from the stated energy inputs; an uncontrolled upper bound is not a counterexample to that modulus at fixed positive age.
This bounded source interface is closed as NO-CANDIDATE, not as a regularity theorem.

No fixed-positive-age or fixed-initial-data terminal counterexample; BCS young-window changing-data quantifiers remain unchanged.
